defectSummary.defect: BoundedCanaryRunner previously exposed a public static method executeIsolatedMockTransport that bypassed v1.2 Gate 0 enforcement by delegating directly to executeTransportPipeline without verifying live canary blocking.
defectSummary.rootCause: While v1.2 Gate 0 in executeLiveCanary unconditionally blocked live execution, executeIsolatedMockTransport remained part of the public static API surface of BoundedCanaryRunner, allowing callers to execute mock transports directly.

remediation.surfaceElimination: Completely removed executeIsolatedMockTransport from BoundedCanaryRunner public static API surface. BoundedCanaryRunner now exposes only verifyReadiness, executeDryRunPlan, and executeLiveCanary.
remediation.moduleScoping: Re-scoped executeTransportPipeline as a non-exported module-scoped function within boundedCanaryRunner.ts, entirely inaccessible outside the module and unreachable at runtime due to Gate 0 blocking executeLiveCanary under v1.2.
remediation.testHarnessIsolation: Relocated historical offline mock transport execution to tests/ai/helpers/historicalCanaryMockTransportHarness.ts. The harness is test-only, strictly requires customFetch (throws if absent, no fallback to globalThis.fetch), and operates strictly on placeholder offline credentials.

coveredScenarios: BoundedCanaryRunner does not expose executeIsolatedMockTransport in its public API
BoundedCanaryRunner does not expose executeTransportPipeline in its public API
BoundedCanaryRunner public API only exposes verifyReadiness, executeDryRunPlan, and executeLiveCanary
HistoricalCanaryMockTransportHarness requires explicit mock transport customFetch and throws if absent
BoundedCanaryRunner.executeLiveCanary with customFetch fails closed at Gate 0 under v1.2 with 0 network calls
All historical transport mechanics (retries, timeouts, telemetry parsing, redirect rejection) preserved in test harness
productionRoutingEnforcementAllowed remains false across all pathways
